post:
This past month has been a period of significant refinement and expansion in how we manage and leverage AI within our development process. We started by shoring up our AI infrastructure, centralizing configurations and integrating robust telemetry for better error handling and logging. This foundational work allowed us to then implement crucial security and performance enhancements, like rate limiting with Upstash Redis and a more streamlined Content Security Policy.

Beyond the technical underpinnings, we've been focused on improving the user experience and our content generation capabilities. This included refining the interview mode UI, tracking session durations, and ensuring the integrity of our AI personas. We also began automating our content creation, initially exploring blog posts generated by Gemini, and then iterating on that by introducing a more targeted follow-up email guide and a system for tracking post history. This shift reflects a move towards more direct and valuable communication, built on a more stable and secure AI foundation.

As we continue to build, how do you approach balancing new feature development with essential infrastructure and security upgrades?
